items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Eddie Robinson, which we called Rabbit. ... This was a kid band, in other words. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Homemade instrument, yeah. We started.

ctx.x: Well, I had my own little outfit. I had the two Matthews boys and myself. We started. Yeah. Then I had another kid named White. Yeah.
And Eddie Robinson, which we called Rabbit. What instruments did they play? This was a kid band, in other words. Kid band. Like playing in the streets.
